verdict.reason: The migration-order failure gives a new delivery lesson, re-dating a migration once the default branch moves ahead, which neither the knowledge nor the earlier lessons contain.

lessons.text: A slice that adds a migration checks the newest migration on the default branch before pushing. If a later-dated one has landed, the slice re-dates its own migration after it and regenerates the committed types, so the order guard and the drift check both pass.
